enumDescriptions: Ask before running a cell that matches `mdRunbook.execution.confirmPatterns`.
Never ask (cells with the `confirm` option still ask).
mdRunbook.execution.confirm.markdownDescription: When to show a confirmation dialog before running a cell. The `confirm` / `no-confirm` cell options override this per cell.

mdRunbook.execution.confirmPatterns.markdownDescription: JavaScript regular expressions (case-insensitive) for risky commands. A cell whose text matches one asks for confirmation before it runs; declining records it as `exit=skipped`.

mdRunbook.output.recordContext.markdownDescription: Commands whose first output line is recorded as an attribute of each output block, e.g. `{ "context": "kubectl config current-context" }` writes `context=prod-eu`. Run through the platform shell in the .md file's folder with a 5 s timeout; failures record `unknown`.

mdRunbook.output.recordContextCacheSecon.description: Reuse recorded context values for this many seconds per runbook instead of running the commands before every cell. 0 = run them every time.

mdRunbook.statusBar.contextAttr.markdownDescription: Which `mdRunbook.output.recordContext` attribute to show in the status bar for the active runbook.
